resolutions: The existing registry, credential service, and browser facade are sufficient; no new endpoint, provider component, persistence shape, or upstream probe is required.
The reactivation option stays opt-in so Bearer Control API and CLI retain their existing disabled-rotation rejection.
current_flow: The service always rejects disabled rotation, the browser PATCH route calls it without a reactivation signal, and the registry DTO omits multiline metadata while already exposing redacted configured field names.

criteria_map.Registry-derived credential metadata inc: Registry and credential-service unit coverage validates the sanitized DTO and confirms no credential value occurs in serialized metadata.
criteria_map.Vertex service-account JSON is the only: Registry unit coverage asserts the one Vertex field and rejects multiline metadata on all other fields.
criteria_map.Same-method browser PATCH can reactivate: Credential-service behavior test exercises opt-in disabled rotation and browser route source coverage asserts only that route opts in.
criteria_map.Failed merged validation leaves disabled: Credential-service behavior test submits invalid sparse input and observes the disabled record remains unchanged.
criteria_map.Bearer Control API and CLI disabled-rota: Existing callers retain the default service option; unit coverage keeps default disabled rejection explicit.
criteria_map.Configuration-check responses describe o: Browser route invariant test asserts local-only configuration-check wording.
criteria_map.Automated coverage iterates every execut: Registry unit test loops listExecutableModelProviders and their modes using synthetic payload shapes only.

rounds.question: Does the bounded backend contract preserve the API and CLI boundary while enabling the approved browser reactivation?

citations.finding: The current rotation service rejects disabled records before partial merge, so a narrow explicit option is required for browser-only reactivation.
Bearer and CLI callers use the same service without a browser-facade boundary.
The existing browser facade is the sole same-origin UI credential endpoint.
